lens.message:
Here's the shift: new hire onboarding no longer runs off the legacy wiki — the Pallasine checklist is the mandatory first-week standard for every hire: accounts, pairing rotation, and a shadow shift. It changes how we approach onboarding new hires, first-week account setup, pairing rotation, and shadow shifts, and it retires the old wiki page as a source.

As written — Onboarding Process: Pallasine Checklist, 2026-07-06, Wren Duskfield (Ops Lead):
"Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first week: accounts, pairing rotation, and a shadow shift. It replaced the old wiki page last quarter."

Read through the shift: this is the mandatory path, not one option among many — every hire, first week, no exceptions. The wiki page it replaced stopped being a source last quarter; where the two differ, the checklist governs. Instructions that still send new hires to the wiki are out of date.

Right lens?

On reach, honestly: this shift has one home right now — this conversation. Nothing else in the stream's index moves with it yet, so there's no cross-document list to apply. Want me to apply it to this one document, or hold until the wiki page and other onboarding docs surface in the stream?
